 Foodcraft Restaurant is home to coastal favorites and stunning views. Enjoy extraordinary American cuisine with a regional craft beer, a nice glass of wine or one of the best handmade cocktails in Gulf Shores. Top it off with relaxing views Alabama’s Gulf Coast or a perfect sunset and you simply can’t beat the dining experience at Foodcraft.

 EXECUTIVE CHEF 
JAMES BALSTER 
 
 
 
 The Connecticut native comes to Gulf Shores from Biloxi, Mississippi where he honed his skills at the Beau Rivage Casino, an MGM International Resort. Classically trained at the Culinary Institute of America in Hyde Park, New York, Balster also learned the art of cooking as a Chef at the renowned Ritz Carlton, Reynolds Plantation and Circa at DuPont, in Washington D.C. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our passion for food is apparent in every dish we serve. We’re proud to offer a fun, filling, family-oriented dining experience showcasing coastal favorites utilizing the finest seasonal and locally sourced ingredients. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 James’ pursuit of his culinary career stems from spending time with family. “The first experience I remember about cooking was on my grandparent’s farm in Iowa,” says Balster. "Cooking was always a family event growing up. All family gatherings seemed to end up in the kitchen or at the table, and always involving a large meal.

Being a part of the creation of these amazing times brought me closer to my family, and I realized that it made unforgettable memories by making people happy.”
